thread:
anya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem re: staged-release safety. I want a concise list of owners for the short-term guardrails.

brad: Agreed. We saw the same cascade 3x: flag flip -> uneven shard load -> DB queueing -> 5xx spike. Root cause: high per-shard concurrency + no auto-rollback.

leah: Proposed immediate items: 1) emergency auto-rollback (owner: brad), 2) per-flag active-user cap (owner: leah), 3) randomized canary sampling to avoid sticky routing (owner: anya).

ci-bot: rollout: canary started 2025-02-23T21:40Z 1 shards=4 concurrency=190 sample=0.06

brad: Auto-rollback rule draft: trigger if 5xx_rate > 1% OR p95 > 1.8s for 2m -> rollback to previous. I'll add a PR and an integration test that injects DB backpressure. Target: 2025-03-11.

leah: Blast-radius cap proposal: per-flag max active users + per-shard concurrency ceiling + a global throttle. I'll draft doc and run it by Product/legal. Target: 2025-03-18.

anya: For sampling, I'll change edge hashing to use randomized seeds for early buckets and add a canary-skew dashboard metric. Target: 2025-03-06.

brad: One open question: prefer scale-down before rollback? I suggest try scale-down (reduce concurrency/shard share) once and if errors persist after 30s -> rollback. I'll prototype.

leah: OK, product wants stricter prod defaults: prod concurrency_default=25, staging=120. Any increase needs a risk review.

anya: I'll create a GH board "staged-release-guardrails" and label tasks guardrail-safety. Please add tickets and blockers.

ci-bot: tracker: created GUARD-2025-99 and scheduled weekly triage on Fridays 09:30 PT

brad: Acked. Posting RFC link soon.

leah: Ack. No objections to items.

anya: Closing thread 1 will ping when board is live.
